newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's Colep placement oversubscribed fourfold.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's Colep placement oversubscribed fourfold.

text.p: Demand for shares in the private placement on Lisbon bourse of Portuguese metal packaging company Colep Portugal-Embalagens, Produtos, Enchimentos e Equipamentos outstripped the available supply more than fourfold, Banco Essi, leader of the operation and bookrunner, said.

"Demand in the private placement of Colep exceeded the available supply of shares more than four times, while demand in the Public Offer for Sale (OPV) is more than two times oversubscribed," an official spokesman said.
In the private placement 3.4 million shares are set aside for domestic and international institutional investors, while 500,000 shares are reserved in the OPV for employees and the general public.
The subscription period ends today and the pricing will take place next Monday. The bookbuilding ranges between 1,850 and 2,300 escudos.
The operation aims to disperse 30 percent of the capital of Colep. The shares will be admitted to Lisbon bourse next Tuesday.
At the same time as the flotation, Colep will raise its capital to 10.4 billion escudos from 6.5 billion.
